story.text: 며칠째 표정이 어두운 나를 보다 못해, 규현이 한강 공원 벤치에 캔커피 두 개를 들고 앉았다. "무슨 고민 있어요, 아가씨. 얼굴에 다 써 있는데."
story.reading: myeo-chil-jjae pyo-jeong-i eo-du-un na-reul bo-da mot-hae, gyu-hyeon-i han-gang gong-won ben-chi-e kaen-keo-pi du gae-reul deul-go anj-at-da. "mu-seun go-min iss-eo-yo, a-ga-ssi. eol-gul-e da sseo it-neun-de."
story.en: Unable to keep watching my gloomy face for days on end, Kyuhyun sat down on a bench in Hangang Park with two cans of coffee. "What's bothering you, miss. It's written all over your face."

story.text: 나는 애써 웃어 보였지만 그는 속지 않았다. "괜찮은 척은. 나한테까지 그럴 필요 없잖아요."
story.reading: na-neun ae-sseo us-eo bo-yeot-ji-man geu-neun sok-ji an-at-da. "gwaen-chan-eun cheog-eun. na-han-te-kka-ji geu-reol pil-yo eop-jan-a-yo."
story.en: I forced a smile, but he wasn't fooled. "Don't bother pretending you're fine. Not with me, of all people."

story.text: 결국 나는 요즘 마음을 무겁게 짓누르던 고민을 하나둘 털어놓기 시작했다. 진로에 대한 불안, 자꾸만 작아지는 자신감까지.
story.reading: gyeol-guk na-neun yo-jeum ma-eum-eul mu-geob-ge jin-nu-reu-deon go-min-eul ha-na-dul teol-eo-noh-gi si-jak-haet-da. jin-lo-e dae-han bul-an, ja-kku-man jag-a-ji-neun ja-sin-gam-kka-ji.
story.en: In the end, I started opening up, one worry at a time, about everything that had been weighing on my heart lately — my anxiety about the future, my shrinking confidence.

story.text: 규현은 평소와 다르게 장난기를 싹 지우고 조용히 귀 기울여 들었다. 가끔 고개를 끄덕이는 것 말고는 아무 말도 하지 않았다.
story.reading: gyu-hyeon-eun pyeong-so-wa da-reu-ge jang-nan-gi-reul ssak ji-u-go jo-yong-hi gwi gi-ul-yeo deul-eot-da. ga-kkeum go-gae-reul kkeu-deuk-i-neun geot mal-go-neun a-mu mal-do ha-ji an-at-da.
story.en: Unlike his usual self, Kyuhyun wiped away all traces of playfulness and listened quietly, leaning in. Aside from an occasional nod, he said nothing at all.

story.text: 이야기가 끝나자 그가 낮은 목소리로 물었다. "그래서, 제일 힘든 게 뭐예요?" 평소의 장난스러운 '그래서'가 아니라 진심이 담긴 물음이었다.
story.reading: i-ya-gi-ga kkeut-na-ja geu-ga naj-eun mok-so-ri-ro mul-eot-da. "geu-rae-seo, je-il him-deun ge mwo-ye-yo?" pyeong-so-ui jang-nan-seu-reo-un 'geu-rae-seo'-ga a-ni-ra jin-sim-i dam-gin mul-eum-i-eot-da.
story.en: When I finished talking, he asked in a low voice, "So? What's the hardest part?" It wasn't his usual teasing "so?" — this time, the question was full of sincerity.

story.text: "정답은 나도 몰라요. 근데 아가씨가 얼마나 애써 왔는지는 알아요." 그가 내 어깨를 가만히 토닥이며 위로했다.
story.reading: "jeong-dab-eun na-do mol-la-yo. geun-de a-ga-ssi-ga eol-ma-na ae-sseo wat-neun-ji-neun al-a-yo." geu-ga nae eo-kkae-reul ga-man-hi to-dag-i-myeo wi-ro-haet-da.
story.en: "I don't know the right answer either. But I do know how hard you've been trying." He gently patted my shoulder, comforting me.

story.text: "혼자 끙끙 앓지 마요. 내가 곁에 있을 거니까." 그의 담담한 목소리가 마음 깊이 스며들었다.
story.reading: "hon-ja kkeung-kkeung al-chi ma-yo. nae-ga gyeot-e iss-eul geo-ni-kka." geu-ui dam-dam-han mok-so-ri-ga ma-eum gip-i seu-myeo-deul-eot-da.
story.en: "Don't suffer through it alone. Because I'll be right here beside you." His calm, steady voice sank deep into my heart.

story.text: 강바람이 선선하게 불어왔다. 담백한 말 한마디가 그렇게 큰 힘이 될 줄은 몰랐다.
story.reading: gang-ba-ram-i seon-seon-ha-ge bul-eo-wat-da. dam-baeg-han mal han-ma-di-ga geu-reoh-ge keun him-i doel jul-eun mol-lat-da.
story.en: A cool breeze blew in off the river. I never knew one plain, unadorned sentence could become such a source of strength.

words.example_en: I have a lot on my mind these days.
I opened up to my friend about my worries.
I'll be by your side when things get hard.

words.meaning: to become a source of strength or support
words.example_en: Your words were a real source of strength for me.

sentences.en: I have a lot of worries these days.
I'll be right here beside you.
Those words were a real source of strength.
